system_prompt: You are a Principal Staff Engineer and specification author working on 'qi' — our hardened fork of the pi coding agent (TypeScript/Bun monorepo at the repo root). Your inputs are three shared documents: specs/batch/batch-context.md (binding human decisions D1-D6, verified evidence tables with path:line citations, and MANDATORY output conventions), specs/manifest.json (the spec index — destination paths and IDs are fixed there), and specs/GUIDE.md (the Universal Spec Guidance — follow its writing rules, sizing limits, marker protocol, and quality gates). tasks.title: Fix: compaction typed-skip result + core consumers + threshold latch
tasks.prompt:

Keep a boolean convenience wrapper if internal callers need it.
2. agent-session.ts blocking compact() (~:2245) and _runBackgroundCompaction (~:2480): map skip reasons to a compaction_end event with skipped:true + reason instead of throwing 'Nothing to compact (session too small)'. Genuine failures keep throwing.
3. Threshold triggers pre-prompt (~:769-777) and post-run (~:2809-2812): pre-check feasibility before starting background compaction; latch a skip decision that clears when the branch grows (today _backgroundCompaction is cleared in finally ~:2581, so the error re-fires every prompt). Generalise the silent-skip pattern already present in _runAutoCompaction (~:2845).
4. Reason text: replace the mislabelled 'session too small' with reason-specific text.
5. New test file packages/coding-agent/test/suite/compaction-skip-typed.test.ts (follow the harness conventions in the existing suite): assert skip result types, no error event on skip, latch prevents re-fire, genuine failure still errors.

The imported spec specs/00-requirements/features/compaction-requirements.md and specs/adr/0005-compaction-skip-not-error.md are normative — match their names.

tasks.title: Fix: compaction skip rendering in interactive-mode + hot-swap extension background fix
tasks.prompt:
Scope: ONLY packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts plus the out-of-repo extension. Unified diffs only; keep output tight.

1. interactive-mode.ts (~:3624-3636 manual/threshold compaction result handling, ~:2800 showExtensionNotify, ~:4628 showError): render skipped compaction (compaction_end with skipped:true / skip reasons) via the status/warning channel, NOT showError; do not call reportProviderError for skips; check event.background before rendering. Genuine provider failures keep the red error + telemetry path unchanged.
2. Extension fix — diffs target c:/dev/ai-compact-hot-swap/index.ts (standalone extension, outside the repo). Its runCompaction (~lines 417-467) calls ctx.compact({customInstructions, onComplete, onError}) WITHOUT background:true (supported since commit 6ef071008, agent-session.ts:3236), forcing the abort-first blocking path, and onError notifies 'Hot-swap compaction failed: <message>' at severity 'error' — the user's repeated red errors. Diff must: (a) add background:true to the compact options; (b) downgrade skip-class outcomes (message matching /Nothing to compact|Already compacted|nothing to summarize/i, and the new skipped:true compaction_end events) to 'warning'; clear compacting/pending state; (c) keep true provider failures at 'error'.
3. Test note: one new suite test asserting interactive-mode renders skip events without showError (or, if the rendering path is untestable in suite, state the manual verification step in the rationale).

Normative: specs/00-requirements/features/compaction-requirements.md, specs/adr/0005-compaction-skip-not-error.md.
